presentation: "The Ruler" Tyrant Demon King has a skill which can deal greater damage the higher his Attack.

rangs.description:
Inflicts [00D5FF]Eradication[-] damage equal to 200 % of Attack on @target.oneEnemy.

[00D5FF]※Eradication: [FFAE00]+[-]60 % Attack when using a skill.
[FFAE00]2x[-] Crit Chance Increase.[-]

[FFAE00]2x[-] Crit Chance Increase.[-]

Decreases all enemies' Defense-related stats by [FFAE00]50%[-] for [FFAE00]2 turns[-], inflicts damage equal to 750 % of Attack and applies a [FFAE00]Lv. 4[-] [00D5FF]Blackout Effect[-] on @target.allEnemies for [FFAE00]2 turns[-].\n\n[00D5FF]※[FFAE00]Lv. 4[-] Blackout Effect: Disables all skills including Ultimate Moves.[-]

passif.description:
At the start of the battle, applies [00D5FF]Ruler's Reign[-] to self for [FFAE00]2 turns[-] and [00D5FF]Retrocession[-] to [00D5FF]Demon allies[-] for [FFAE00]2 turns[-]. For [FFAE00]each[-] [00D5FF]Retrocession[-] effect removed at the beginning of the allies' turn, increases the hero's Attack-related stats by [FFAE00]18%[-]. In addition, if the hero is [00D5FF]alive on the battlefield[-], all [00D5FF]Commandments are sealed[-], and for [FFAE00]each[-] dead [00D5FF]ally with a Commandment[-], the hero's Attack increases by [FFAE00]30%[-].

[00D5FF]※Ruler's Reign: The hero's damage taken from skills during the enemy's turn does not exceed [FFAE00]50%[-] of Max HP.
Once removed, all Debuffs are removed from the hero along with it, then all of the hero's stats are increased by [FFAE00]20%[-] and skills are ranked up.
[00D5FF]※Retrocession: [FFAE00]-20%[-] damage taken.[-]

relique.description: Tyrant Demon King's Holy Relic (Weapon).\n[DC143C]A sword containing the curse of Fafnir. It's a sword that lay hidden in Fafnir's treasure hoard, imbued with a terrible curse that prevents anyone from touching it.[-]

passif.description:
Increases the hero's Attack-related stats by [FFAE00]10%[-] for [FFAE00]each[-] [00D5FF]Retrocession[-] effect on allies.

For [FFAE00]each[-] [00D5FF]Retrocession[-] effect removed, the hero recovers [FFAE00]10%[-] of their Max HP.

When a [00D5FF]Retrocession[-] is removed from the hero, the hero's damage taken decreases by [FFAE00]50%[-] for [FFAE00]2 turns[-].
